text:
sofia: Idea: a small "Onboarding Mentor Awards" pilot during May cohort week. Short 20min slot to recognize outstanding buddy/mentor contributions + quick how-to on nominating. Wed like a panel of 3 mentors to share 1 story each. Anyone available to help coordinate?

maria: Love it. I can put together a one-slide how-to for mentors and a short nomination rubric (impact, time saved, onboarding success).

dan: I can be on the panel Wed 11:30am PT and share a short example. Will need slot + room.

hr-bot: FYI: award qualifies as a spot award and follows normal tax/reporting rules. See /handbook/comp-and-bene/spot-awards for details. Payroll cutoff reminder: 18th 11:59pm PT.

kate: Logistics: hybrid ok? Small room + Zoom. I can book the huddle and set up streaming. Room cap 20.

paul: I can draft a short 2-line calendar blurb and handle comms to the new hire cohort. Also happy to manage small snacks (budget $100).

carmen: Can we add a consent line for mentors whod prefer anonymized shoutouts? Some prefer privacy.

maria: Yes add a checkbox on the form: "Share name publicly" vs "Share anonymized excerpt". Also include an optional field: "how the mentor made onboarding easier (1 sentence)".

sofia: Great. Volunteers: maria (rubric + slide), dan (panel), paul (comms + snacks), kate (room), carmen (consent notes). Please add availability in the form by EOD Friday: https://forms.gle/onboard-mentor-awards.

dan: Quick ask: will winners get a small gift card? Need to confirm budget and taxability.

hr-bot: Gift cards are taxable in most jurisdictions. Finance suggests $25 per award and to route purchases through procurement if >$500/month.

paul: Ok $25 x 5 mentors max. Will coordinate purchase and receipt tracking.

maria: I'll add an FAQ slide: eligibility, nomination timeline, selection process, and tax note. Also prepping 2 anonymized nomination examples to show during the slot.

sofia: Perfect. Final checklist here: form live (sofia), rubric & slides (maria), panel (dan + 2 volunteers), room + stream (kate), comms & snacks (paul), consent language (carmen), budget confirm (finance via hr-bot). Will post calendar invite once form has headcount. Thanks! :tada:
